title: OpenAI · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 新增 API credits for ChatGPT subscribers 条目，说明 ChatGPT Pro 和 Business 订阅用户每月可领取最高 500 美元免费 API credits。

added_lines: Eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can now claim up to $500 per month in free API credits as a subscription benefit. Activate the benefit from ChatGPT or API Platform by linking an API organization you own. See API credits for ChatGPT subscribers for credit amounts, eligibility, and how to claim.
